cards.name: Shazmir
cards.lore: A little flourish. A lot of fire.
cards.characterDescription: Charcoal-and-silver court fire-dancer with a simple warm-grey sparse-fur facial mask, amber eyes and a roguish smile.
cards.costumeDescription: Short crimson doublet with asymmetric ochre edging, broad cream cuffs and a dark-red waist sash.
cards.poseDescription: Low twisting dance crouch, head turned toward the fan on his right, with one fan-holding forepaw and one counterbalancing forepaw.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE square full-bleed character illustration for Project: Prowl's established medieval elemental CAT CARD COLLECTION.
Input images 1–4 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: existing Sizzle Mittens, Whisker Whirl, Moatgate Mau and Charmae Emberhem. None is an edit target. Create ONE NEW character; do not copy any reference character, costume, pose or prop.
Collection matching is the top priority: the SAME ARTIST, line-weight hierarchy, feline proportions, detail density, face construction and simple matte rendering as the supplied cards. Bold warm-black outer contour, thinner deliberate interior lines. Smooth flat colour masses, at most ONE crisp HARD-EDGED cel shadow and ONE tiny flat highlight per material. No increased detail because this is a new character.
Proportions: oversized expressive feline head, large eyes, short broad feline muzzle, extremely short neck, ROUND SHORT torso, broad haunches and SHORT feline limbs. A cute sturdy cat, not a tall humanoid, adult human waist, furry human hands or dog. Exactly ONE head, ONE torso, ONE tail, TWO forelegs visibly attached to shoulders and TWO hind legs continuously attached to haunches. A prop-holding foreleg replaces a planted foreleg; never add a fifth limb. Rounded feline mitten paws, at most three broad toe divisions, no human fingers or extra thumb bumps. Trace every limb to its paw and preserve clear negative space or justified occlusion around overlaps.
Composition: square 1254x1254 opaque artwork master, entire character, both ears, all four paws, tail and primary prop inside the canvas with modest breathing room. Character LARGE, head in the upper-middle, BOTH eyes visible and not in the upper-left element badge or upper-right Power badge zones. Main prop/action close under or beside the face so it is legible in a shallow landscape card-art window. Avoid a tiny subject with lots of empty space. Sparse flat background: ONE large elemental circle, ONE simple ground shape and no more than two broad supporting accents. No castles, distant scenery, shadow silhouettes, secondary characters or clutter.
Output: ARTWORK ONLY. No card frame, UI, title, lettering, numbers, symbols printed on clothing, watermark, signature or logo.

Subject: SHAZMIR ASHVEIL, male FIRE UNCOMMON LINK court fire-dancer, based on Shazmeer. Mischievous, self-assured and graceful, a roguish closed-mouth smile and one subtly raised eyebrow; NOT frightening, skeletal or villainous.
Breed/colours: LYKOl (Lykoi), recognisable large upright ears, charcoal-and-silver coat, sparse facial fur forming a simple dusty warm-grey bare-skin mask around eyes and muzzle, GOLDEN AMBER eyes. Show the silver/charcoal coat through a few broad clean grouped shapes, not speckles or realistic wiry hairs. Bare portions are warm grey, never a cream tuxedo muzzle, white socks, skull, wound or exposed bone. One slender charcoal tail with a few grouped silhouette tufts; no fox plume.
Clothing: a SHORT CRIMSON medieval court doublet fitted around his round cat torso, asymmetric OCHRE split hem ending above hind-leg joints, broad CREAM wrist cuffs, and one plain close-fitting dark-red waist sash. Purposeful broad tailoring, no full-length robe, cape, wizard hat, armour, patterned tights, jewelry or tiny ornament.
Action/silhouette: a LOW TWISTING DANCE CROUCH, torso rotating toward image-right. One short hind paw planted slightly forward, the other folded/braced diagonally behind with its short continuous leg visible. Both rear paws are connected and share the same ground plane; no aerial jump, running or dragging foot. Upright head turned THREE-QUARTER toward the open fan on image-right, both amber eyes visible, not a generic viewer-facing tilted mascot pose.
Exactly TWO short forelegs: the near foreleg crosses forward from its shoulder and its rounded grey paw firmly grips the ONE closed pivot handle at the bottom of ONE OPEN FOLDING FIRE-FAN held across the front of his chest. The far foreleg extends a little behind/to the other side for dance balance, ending in ONE small relaxed open feline paw. Each arm remains visible from shoulder through sleeve to paw; don't add another balancing arm.
Fan geometry: one broad, balanced shallow semicircle of FIVE large red-and-gold fan panels on dark ribs, all ribs radiating continuously from the SAME single pivot held by the same paw. No loose panels, disconnected ribs, second handle, extra fan, tiny filigree or lettering. Fan sits beside/below his face, never covering eyes or arm connections.
Element action: ONE bold orange-and-gold FIRE ARC sweeps outward from the fan's outer edge, following the dance motion, with three isolated chunky sparks. Hard graphic flame lobes, no realistic smoke or glowing fire. Keep paws and the fan's continuous pivot/ribs readable.
Backdrop: warm cream field with ONE uniform brick-red circle, one plain flat warm-grey stone floor shape and small ground shadow only. No stage curtains, audience, furniture, background figures or flags.
Uncommon status: skilful modest magic, not huge legendary spectacle. Keep the same compact cat scale and clean collection finish.
